title: Daryl Pack v0.1
description: Envelope of a Daryl knowledge pack. Governed by ADR-PACK-0001 (composition law) and ADR-PRL-0014 (context referents). The envelope RESERVES all fourteen sections so later versions need not rewrite it, but the v0.1 proof carries ONLY 'vocabulary' and 'required_checks': a conforming v0.1 resolver MUST NOT compose, and MUST NOT hash into the effective manifest, any section marked x-daryl-proof-scope=reserved. Where this schema and ADR-PACK-0001 disagree, the ADR governs and this schema is the defect.

identity.description: ADR-PRL-0014 referents. Declared, never inferred from path, file name, storage, deployment region or model. An absent referent reads as unknown, never as universal.

pack_id.description: Stable logical identity. Not the file, not the path, not the repository.

pack_version.description: semver MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. A pack is immutable at a version; changing governed content requires a new version. The citable unit is pack_id@pack_version.

layer.description: Precedence rank. The chain is closed at four: derogation is NOT a layer (ADR-PACK-0001 R2).

domain.description: A body of professional thinking, not a task type or a shard family.

jurisdiction.description: A regulatory space, NOT a deployment region, data-residency zone or locale. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 upper, optionally XX-REGION.

org_id.description: ADR-PRL-0010 referent, CITED AND REUSED UNCHANGED. Not redefined here or in ADR-PRL-0014.

compatibility.description: What this pack requires of its neighbours and of the resolver. Violations are refused in phase P2 with compatibility_violation.

version_range.description: v0.1 supports only a caret-free explicit range of the form '>=A.B.C <D.E.F'. Deliberately minimal: range grammars are a source of implementation divergence.

composition.description: Per-field control (ADR-PACK-0001 R3/R3bis) and derogations (R6). Derogation is not a layer: it is a field-level permission effect evaluated inside composition.

controls.description: A control names a leaf path or a path prefix; for a given leaf the LONGEST matching declaration wins. A leaf covered by no declaration takes the fail-closed default {merge: replace, override: forbidden}.

path.description: Dotted path rooted at a section name, e.g. 'vocabulary.terms'. No wildcards.

merge.description: HOW values combine. Fixed by the introducing layer, immutable, never overridable. 'append', 'union' and 'intersect' apply to arrays only. 'union'/'intersect' are commutative and therefore the only semantics peers may both contribute to (R4).

override.description: WHO may change it. Monotonically tightenable only: open < requires_derogation < forbidden. 'forbidden' is ABSOLUTE — no authority, no derogation, no higher layer lifts it (R5).

vocabulary.description: IN PROOF SCOPE for v0.1. Governed content tree: objects are namespaces, leaves are scalars or arrays.

required_checks.description: IN PROOF SCOPE for v0.1. The 'required' axis only. swarm.v0.1's WorkReceipt keeps three never-merged axes — required_checks / claimed_checks / actual_checks — with coverage computed in replay and never trusted from the author. A pack supplies the first axis and MUST NOT touch the other two.

provenance.description: Who authored the pack and under what authority. Descriptive: never an input to precedence.

source_ref.description: Opaque provenance reference. NEVER read as identity, precedence or ordering.

signatures.description: NOT VERIFIED IN v0.1. Ed25519 exists in dsm-primitives but is not wired into the governance path; a v0.1 resolver checks presence and structure only. Until wired, a signature is an audit trail, not an authorization.

rfc3339_utc.description: RFC 3339, UTC, 'Z' suffix only. Local offsets are refused: an offset is a carrier detail, and evaluation time is a governed input (R8).

governed_section.description: An object tree. Objects are namespaces; leaves are scalars or arrays. Arrays of arrays and arrays of objects are refused in v0.1 — canonical set semantics over nested containers are an unnecessary divergence risk this early.

reserved_section.description: RESERVED in v0.1. The envelope accepts the key so later versions need not rewrite it. A conforming v0.1 resolver MUST NOT compose it and MUST NOT hash it into the effective manifest. Reserving a name is not proving a behaviour.

derogation.description: ADR-PACK-0001 R6. Authority, scope and expiry are ALL required; any of them missing is derogation_invalid, fail-closed, even if the path it names is never contested. A derogation never wins a value and never lifts 'forbidden'.

scope.description: A finite, LITERAL list of leaf paths. No wildcards, no prefixes, no 'all'. A derogation that does not literally name the path does not cover it. (Controls may be declared by prefix; derogations may not — a control is authored by the field's owner, a derogation is an exception against that owner.)

expires_at.description: Bounded. An open-ended derogation is malformed, not permanent.

signature.description: Presence and structure checked in v0.1; cryptographic validity NOT verified (prerequisite not delivered).
